notes: Built from Axis's current HORIZON terms PDF (which mentions changes for cards issued from 1 Sept 2026). The cardholder confirms there is no annual-fee waiver and values 1 EDGE Mile at ₹1. The terms give no forex mark-up.

items.label: 1% fuel surcharge waived on ₹400–₹5,000 transactions, up to ₹400 a statement month
items.clause: with a max cap of INR 400 on wavier in the statement month

earnRules.label: 2 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on other spends (including travel agents and OTAs)
earnRules.clause: Other spends: 2 EDGE Miles for every INR 100

earnRules.label: 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on Axis Bank Travel EDGE
earnRules.clause: 5 EDGE Miles for every INR 100 spent

earnRules.label: 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 booking directly with airlines (travel agents and OTAs earn 2)
earnRules.clause: Bookings via travel agents ... shall be eligible for only 2 EDGE Miles for every INR 100 spent

exclusions.label: No EDGE Miles on fuel, rent, wallet loads and gift cards, utilities, telecom, insurance, education, government, transport and tolls
exclusions.clause: Transportation & Tolls, Utilities and Telecom, Insurance, Educational Institutions, Govt. Institutions, Wallet/Gift cards, Rent, Fuel

lounge.label: 2 international lounge visits a calendar quarter
lounge.clause: 2 complimentary lounge access per calendar quarter

lounge.label: 8 domestic lounge visits a calendar quarter on Visa Signature (6 on Mastercard World)

otherBenefits.label: Welcome: 5,000 EDGE Miles if your first transaction (within 30 days of issue) is ₹1,000 or more
otherBenefits.detail: A smaller first transaction loses the benefit. Not for cards switched from another Axis card. Cards issued from 1 Sept 2026: miles post within 60 days.
otherBenefits.clause: 5,000 EDGE Miles on the first transaction over INR 1,000 within 30 days

otherBenefits.label: Renewal: 1,500 EDGE Miles each card anniversary from the second year (primary card)
otherBenefits.clause: 1,500 miles each anniversary, starting from the second anniversary year

otherBenefits.label: EDGE Miles redeem for partner miles, Travel EDGE bookings and the catalogue (minimum 500)
otherBenefits.detail: The current terms point to a separate Miles Transfer programme for ratios; the cardholder values 1 mile at ₹1.

otherBenefits.label: Lost card liability cover up to ₹10 lakh
otherBenefits.detail: Covers fraud up to 2 days before you block the card; needs a police complaint and claim within 30 days.
otherBenefits.clause: up to a limit of INR 10 lacs

otherBenefits.label: No annual-fee waiver on this card
otherBenefits.detail: The ₹3,000 + GST annual fee is charged every year regardless of spend.
otherBenefits.clause: There is no fee-waiver for Axis
